# @surfaces-ui/trace

Tracing for Surfaces UI: a bounded recorder of messages, problems, state, events, agent turns and service calls, with replay for time travel. Never holds row values or credentials.

The recorder behind the developer tools. It keeps names, SQL, counts, timings and errors, and never row values or credentials.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/trace react
```

`react` is a peer dependency: your app provides it.

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
